name: Dobot stop/start Lua post-processor
summary: Dobot Lua translation with extrusion off during explicit and implicit travel.

evidence.label: EXPERIMENTAL
evidence.scope: Software translation only; this stop/start tool configuration has not been physically validated.

guarantees: Requires current executable-export approval for dobot-stop.
Follows explicit travel coordinates including hops.
Switches extrusion off before travel, on before print strokes.
Print/travel helper selection follows intent, independently of distance.
knownLimitations: Zero dwell defaults assume immediate response. Set extrusionTiming in the instance profile for a real tool.
Hops must be present in approved plan geometry. Export does not invent them.
